name: Pangasinan SpeedCubing Open 3 2019
information: Registration fee is 300php for the first 3 events. We will accept walk in competitors, registration fee is 400php for base fee. Additional 50php will be implemented per extra event there on. Payment-first basis will be implemented for competitors coming from the Philippines. Refer to the competition tabs for the payment details. Registration fee includes certificate of participation, scoresheets.
